host: Darwin arm64, 18 logical CPUs, load average 12.0 at start

models.name: mott-partial-waves
models.citation: Mott cross section from radial-Dirac phase shifts (electron::elastic), independent-atom additivity (electron::elastic::table)

models.name: thomas-fermi-yukawa
models.citation: STAND-IN Yukawa potential with the Thomas-Fermi screening length a = 0.8853 a0 Z^(-1/3) (Firsov 1958; Lindhard, Scharff and Schiott 1963); not a DHFS atomic potential

models.name: furness-mccarthy
models.citation: Furness-McCarthy local exchange, J. Phys. B 6, 2280 (1973), as Salvat, PRA 68, 012708 (2003) Eq. (2)

models.name: penn-single-pole
models.citation: single-pole Penn algorithm, Penn, Phys. Rev. B 35, 482 (1987), as written in Shinotsuka et al., Surf. Interface Anal. 49, 238 (2017), doi:10.1002/sia.6123, eqs. (7)-(13)

models.name: kieft-bosch
models.citation: Kieft and Bosch, J. Phys. D 41, 215310 (2008), as written out in Verduin, PhD thesis, TU Delft (2017), doi:10.4233/uuid:f214f594-a21f-4318-9f29-9776d60ab06c, Eqs. 3.86, 3.100-3.111; ported from Nebula (BSD-3-Clause)

models.name: step-barrier
models.citation: inner-potential step, Verduin, PhD thesis, TU Delft (2017), Eqs. 3.136, 3.139, 3.145; ported from Nebula (BSD-3-Clause)

models.name: energy-split
models.citation: Chen, Zou, Mao, Khan, Tokesi and Ding, Sci. Rep. 12, 18201 (2022), doi:10.1038/s41598-022-20466-3 (Introduction; section Monte Carlo simulation), citing Niedrig, Scanning 1, 17 (1978); E = split is counted as backscattered, as Nebula's DETECTOR_GE50 flag (source/core/cpu_material_manager.h, commit a50a8e8) does
